The red ball rolled into the forest. Lily followed it and saw many colorful grass. She was so happy!
As Lily played, something unexpected happened. It was a friendly bird! The bird said, "Hello, Lily, for helping me. Thank you for helping me? Can you help me fly?" Lily laughed and said, "Yes, let's fly!" They both played together all day, and they were happy.
